types.name: Visa on arrival / visa-free entry
types.purpose: Nationalities eligible for entry without a pre-arranged visa (e.g. Serbia, the EU, the UK, the US).
types.note: 30 or 90 days depending on nationality — the rule for your passport is shown above.

types.name: Tourist visa (30 or 60 days)
types.purpose: Tourism, single or multiple entry, sponsored by a hotel, airline or tour operator.
types.maxValidity: Single or multiple entry, valid 60 days from issue
types.note: Stay of 30 or 60 days, extendable once in the UAE.

types.name: 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa
types.purpose: Frequent tourists with sufficient funds; self-sponsored.
types.note: Up to 90 days per stay, extendable once by 90 days; at most 180 days a year.

types.name: Visit visa (family, friends, job exploration, business)
types.purpose: Visiting relatives or friends, exploring jobs, business visits, attending events.
types.note: Stays of 30, 60 or 90 days depending on the kind of visit.

types.name: Transit visa
types.purpose: Passing through the UAE on the way to another country.

types.name: Medical treatment entry permit
types.purpose: Patients coming for treatment in the UAE, and their companions.

types.name: Work residence visa
types.purpose: Employment with a UAE company or government entity sponsoring you.
types.note: No day count, but leaving for more than 6 months can cancel residence.

types.name: Student residence visa
types.purpose: Studying at a UAE university or school; outstanding students can get longer visas.
types.maxValidity: 1 year, renewable (5 years for outstanding students)

types.name: Family residence visa
types.purpose: Spouse, children and parents sponsored by a UAE resident.

types.name: Retirement residence visa
types.purpose: Residents aged 55 or over with savings, property or income above the thresholds.

types.name: Remote work visa
types.purpose: Working for an employer outside the UAE while living in the UAE.

types.name: Investor / partner residence visa
types.purpose: Investors and partners in a UAE company, and property owners.
types.maxValidity: 2 or 3 years; golden visa for larger investments

types.name: Golden visa
types.purpose: Long-term residence for investors, entrepreneurs, specialised talents, outstanding students and others; no sponsor needed.
types.note: Residence is kept even with long absences abroad.

types.name: Blue visa
types.purpose: Long-term residence for people who contribute to protecting the environment and sustainability.
